rows.en: ＊Riko＊＠１０３＿０２４I might end up holding you back.＝＠１０３＿０２５If you've thought about that￥and still want me...
＊Riko＊＠１０３＿０２６Fine. To repay your faith in me,￥I'll... I'll give it my all!!
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Riko Depart　－

＊Riko＊＠０８９＿０１１I'd completely given up. I￥thought I just didn't have what￥it takes to qualify...＝＠０８９＿０１２But... I'm really going. To that￥beautiful blue Elan.＝＠０８９＿０１３I can't believe you'd choose me￥when I'm like this!＝＠０８９＿０１４But...＝＠０８９＿０１５If our places were switched,￥I think I'd have done the same.＝＠０８９＿０１６Never mind what's in it for￥me... I'd have chosen you...

＊Riko＊＠０８９＿０１７I'm so happy!＝＠０８９＿０１８Part of it is standing here as￥one of the qualified, but more￥than anything...＝＠０８９＿０１９I'm happiest that you chose me!＝＠０８９＿０２１Thank you! I'll work as hard as￥I can so I never let you down!!

＊Riko＊＠０８９＿０１７I'm so happy!＝＠０８９＿０１８Part of it is standing here as￥one of the qualified, but more￥than anything...＝＠０８９＿０２０I'm happiest that you saw what￥I'm worth!＝＠０８９＿０２１Thank you! I'll work as hard as￥I can so I never let you down!!
